description: Runner-independent acceptance contract for a headless power-electronics simulator.

policy.tolerance_status: preliminary engineering CI gates; not normative accuracy claims

classifications.verification: Comparison with mathematics, conservation laws, or an independently evaluated exact solution.
classifications.compatibility: Comparison with another simulator or a published simulator result; not physical validation.
classifications.physical_validation: Comparison with held-out experimental measurements that were not used for calibration.

policy.calibration_split: Calibration and held-out validation cases must be disjoint and versioned.

event_comparison.alignment: Align waveforms only on matching labeled switching events.
event_comparison.reason: A small event-time displacement must not dominate waveform RMSE at a discontinuity.

failure_rules: Any non-finite metric value fails an applicable blocking gate.
Every case selected by an applicable blocking gate must pass.
A missing required local artifact is not-run and cannot be reported as pass.
Changing a reference, alignment rule, metric, or tolerance requires a suite revision.

nightly.note: External references must already exist in the approved local artifact store.

manual.note: Physical validation is run only after dataset provenance and the held-out split are reviewed.

relative_error.note: The scale must be declared per signal; it prevents division by numerical zero.

nrmse.note: Apply the event policy before computing a comparison-view NRMSE.

normalized_residual.note: Used for KCL and KVL residuals with current and voltage scales respectively.

energy_balance_relative.formula: abs(E_in - E_out - E_loss - delta_E_stored) / max(abs(E_in), E_scale * 1e-12)

normalized_max_violation.note: The sign convention must make a forbidden state positive; used for unilateral-device constraints.

absolute_fraction_error.note: 0.01 is one percentage point when the reported quantity is efficiency or another fraction.

temperature_abs_K.note: A temperature difference in kelvin is numerically equal to a difference in degrees Celsius.

thd_abs_fraction.note: 0.01 is one percentage point of THD. The harmonic bandwidth and window must be identical.

tests.title: Linear circuit kernel
tests.purpose: Verify stamping, algebraic constraints, transient integration, controlled sources, and conservation before switching models are introduced.
cases: resistive DC networks
RC charge and discharge
series and parallel RLC natural and driven response
independent and controlled voltage/current sources
tests.oracle: Closed-form DC solution and independently evaluated matrix exponential for each linear interval.

gates.quantity: DC node voltages and branch currents

tests.title: CCM DC-DC hybrid converters
tests.purpose: Verify topology changes and state propagation for buck, boost, and inverting buck-boost converters operating in continuous conduction mode.
cases: buck startup and periodic steady state
boost startup and periodic steady state
inverting buck-boost startup and periodic steady state
ARCH parameter corners and a nominal buck case: Vs 11.95-12.05 V, R 0.95-1.05 ohm, C 23.75-26.25 uF, L 47.5-52.5 uH, switching period 24.5-25.5 us, duty ratio 0.6
tests.oracle: ARCH hybrid state matrices propagated independently with expm(A * dt), including exact affine input handling and switching-boundary samples.

tests.title: DCM, BCM, and ideal-diode events
tests.purpose: Verify unilateral-device constraints, zero-current localization, mode transitions, and absence of artificial reverse current.
cases: buck load sweep crossing the CCM/DCM boundary
boost load sweep crossing the CCM/DCM boundary
inverting buck-boost load sweep crossing the CCM/DCM boundary
boundary-conduction point
ideal diode turn-off into a resistive load
tests.oracle: Piecewise analytical mode solution with an independently bracketed and refined zero-current event.

gates.quantity: cycle mean output and conduction interval

tests.title: Single- and three-phase diode rectifiers
tests.purpose: Verify periodic source handling, diode commutation, pulse count, source-inductance overlap, and harmonic extraction.
cases: single-phase full bridge with resistive and current-smoothed loads
three-phase six-pulse bridge with zero source inductance
three-phase six-pulse bridge with finite per-phase source inductance
tests.oracle: Closed-form average voltage and an independently solved piecewise commutation interval. For the three-phase bridge: Vdc = 3*V_LL_peak/pi at Ls=0 and Vdc = (3/pi)*(V_LL_peak - omega*Ls*I_dc_avg) under the stated continuous-current assumptions.

external_artifacts.optional: independent-engine waveform for nonblocking compatibility comparison

tests.title: Two-level voltage-source inverter
tests.purpose: Verify SPWM/SVPWM scheduling, complementary switching, dead time, three-phase symmetry, fundamental output, and harmonic analysis.
cases: three-phase two-level SPWM into balanced R and RL loads
SVPWM or six-step schedule with known switching vectors
dead-time sweep including zero dead time and a deliberately exaggerated value
modulation-index sweep within the linear region
tests.oracle: Independently generated switching schedule plus Fourier coefficients over an integer number of fundamental periods; analytical fundamental in the linear modulation region.

external_artifacts.optional: independent-engine waveform for nonblocking compatibility comparison

tests.title: Buck-converter small-signal response
tests.purpose: Verify perturbation injection, frequency-response extraction, phase unwrapping, and agreement between a switching model and its averaged low-frequency model.
cases: control-to-output response of an ideal CCM buck
input-to-output response of an ideal CCM buck
frequency points from two decades below the LC pole to no more than 0.1*f_switch for switching-to-average comparison
tests.oracle: Analytical averaged state-space transfer function. A separately acquired independent-engine AC sweep is an optional compatibility oracle.

gates.quantity: switching model or optional independent-engine result versus analytical model
switching model or optional independent-engine result versus analytical model

external_artifacts.optional: independent-engine sweep with a provenance record

tests.title: Semiconductor conduction and double-pulse switching losses
tests.purpose: Verify multidimensional loss-table interpolation and compare Eon, Eoff, and Erec under explicitly matched DPT conditions.
cases: exact interpolation knots and interior synthetic surfaces
Infineon FS380R12A6T4B typical Vce(sat), Vf, Eon, Eoff, and Erec curves
ROHM BSM120D12P2C005 DPT at Vds 600 V, Vgs 18/0 V, Rg 3.9 ohm, module parasitic approximately 25 nH, and circuit parasitic approximately 15 nH
tests.oracle: Synthetic tables for interpolation verification; curated manufacturer curve points for provisional physical comparison. DPT energy uses the same voltage/current definitions, integration windows, gate resistance, commutation device, temperature, and parasitics as the reference.

gates.quantity: synthetic table value at every knot
conduction voltage or loss against digitized typical curve
gates.scope: provisional; only at matched current and temperature

gates.quantity: Eon, Eoff, and Erec against digitized typical curve
gates.scope: provisional; only at fully matched DPT conditions

limitations: Datasheet curves are typically representative, not traceable raw measurements or guaranteed production limits.
A switching-energy comparison is invalid when voltage, current, junction temperature, gate drive, gate resistance, commutation diode, parasitics, or integration windows differ.
The 5% and 10% physical gates must be replaced or uncertainty-qualified when raw measurement uncertainty becomes available.

tests.title: Foster thermal impedance and arbitrary power profiles
tests.purpose: Verify thermal RC propagation, step response, superposition/convolution, and the asymptotic junction-to-case resistance.
cases: diode Foster network r=[0.015,0.07,0.055,0.02] K/W and the same tau vector
piecewise-constant and pulsed arbitrary power histories
tests.oracle: Zth(t) = sum_i r_i*(1-exp(-t/tau_i)); arbitrary power response from independently evaluated superposition of step increments or convolution.

gates.quantity: temperature response to arbitrary power profile
gates.scope: every sampled point outside declared input discontinuities

limitations: Foster internal node temperatures do not correspond to physical package layers.
Equivalent terminal impedance does not imply equivalent internal temperatures between Foster and Cauer networks.

tests.title: End-to-end electrothermal buck converter
tests.purpose: Exercise the full switching, loss, thermal, control, initialization, reporting, and energy-accounting chain on one reproducible converter.

phases.title: Held-out experimental electrothermal validation

gates.scope: held-out steady operating points; one percentage point
held-out experiments after only documented time-origin alignment

activation_requirements: freeze calibration and held-out subsets before model tuning
document sensor accuracy, sampling, boundary conditions, and uncertainty
replace provisional gates with uncertainty-aware acceptance criteria where possible
